results.title: Engine overheating: first steps (synthetic)
results.content: Turn off the air conditioning, pull over safely, switch the engine off, and wait for it to cool. Do not open the radiator cap while hot; pressurised coolant can cause severe burns. Do not continue driving with the temperature warning on.

results.title: Coolant top-up (synthetic)
results.content: Only add coolant after the engine has fully cooled. A repeated drop in level indicates a leak and the vehicle should be towed, not driven.
